title: Majesty Yachts USA announces sale of two Majesty 140 superyachts
description: Majesty Yachts USA has announced the sale of two Majesty 140 superyachts to American buyers. Greg Terraglio, Managing Partner of Majesty Yachts USA, in partnership with Andrew Miles from Miles Yacht Group brokered the deal on hull number 3.
html:
Majesty 140 © Gulf Craft

Majesty Yachts USA has announced the sale of two Majesty 140 superyachts to American buyers. Greg Terraglio, Managing Partner of Majesty Yachts USA, in partnership with Andrew Miles from Miles Yacht Group brokered the deal on hull number 3.

Terraglio and Ralph Navarro with FYI Yachts brokered the deal on hull number 4.

“Since winning the NBC Sports ‘Best in Show Award’ at its American market debut during the 2019 Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show, there has been great interest in the Majesty 140,” said Terraglio, a managing member of Majesty Yachts USA. “Our advantage as a stocking dealer to provide immediate delivery of new yachts adds to Majesty’s positioning as a brand to be reckoned with in the US superyacht marketplace.”

Majesty 140 – photo © Gulf CraftThe multiple award-winning Majesty 140 features extensive glass side windows with stunning panoramic views, a signature feature of all Majesty yachts. The tri-deck superyacht’s main deck boasts opulent finishes, a full beam owner’s stateroom with plentiful light and sweeping views, and a private extendable balcony with a jacuzzi tub.

Powered by twin 16V 2000 M96 series engines churning out 2,600hp each, the yacht is capable of a top speed of 20 knots and cruises comfortably at 17 knots. It boasts an extended range of 4,750nm at an economical speed of 10 knots. Majesty 140 Hull #3 – photo © Majesty Yachts

Photo Credit: Courtesy of Florida Yachts International

Majesty Yachts builds boats from 49 to 175 feet. Designed to create a “oneness with the sea,” the yachts are distinguished by expansive deck areas and large indoor/outdoor sun decks; extendable balconies; fully equipped water sports garages; and beach clubs, where guests can be closer to the water. Spacious salons and generous entertainment areas framed by walls of seamless windows carry the feeling of openness to the interior. The shallow draft of most Majesty Yachts makes them ideal for cruising throughout the Bahamas. Majesty 140 Hull #3 Pilot House – photo © Majesty Yachts

Majesty 140 Technical Specifications:

  • Length overall: 141 ft. 5 in.
  • Length Water Line: 116 ft. 8 in.
  • Beam: 27 ft. 3 in.
  • Draft: 7 ft. 2 in.
  • Displacement: 210T (approximate)
  • Fuel capacity: 11,770 US gal
  • Fresh water capacity: 1,780 US gal
  • Generators: 2 x 100 kW
  • Engines: 2 x 2600 HP
  • Current Price: $19,900,000 USD
Majesty 140 Hull #3 at Aston Martin Residence – photo © Majesty Yachts The Majesty 140 has the largest gross tonnage of any 140-foot yacht ever built and features three fold-down hydraulic balconies. Hull number three is LY3 and RENA certified and flagged US and has obtained USCG and US EPA compliance for a foreign-built yacht.

Majesty Yachts USA has established sales locations at Fort Lauderdale’s Bahia Mar Yachting Center and at Sovereign Super Yachts, in Stuart, Florida. Majesty 140 Hull #3 Salon – photo © Majesty Yachts Majesty 140 Hull #3 Master Stateroom – photo © Majesty Yachts
